instruction.text: Insert the correct form for indirect speech.

atoms.a: Danielle announced, “I will submit the report by Monday.”
atoms.b: She announced she ((++would_submit will_submit were_submitted)) the report by Monday.

feedback.wrong: Das will-future der direkten Rede wird in der indirekten Rede zum conditional.

atoms.a: Elyas confirmed, “I am going to start studying law next fall.”
atoms.b: He confirmed that he ((++was_going_to is_going_to will)) start studying law the following fall.

feedback.wrong: Das going-to future der direkten Rede wird in der indirekten Rede zu was/were going to + Infinitiv.

atoms.b: They said that they ((would_have_appreciated ++would_appreciate will_appreciate)) my feedback.

feedback.wrong: Das conditional der direkten Rede wird in der indirekten Rede nicht verändert.

atoms.a: The expert claimed, “It would have been unwise to ignore the data.”
atoms.b: The expert claimed that it ((++would_have_been was has_been)) unwise to ignore the data.

feedback.wrong: Das conditional perfect der direkten Rede bleibt in der indirekten Rede conditional perfect.

atoms.a: The manager emphasizes, “The guests will have arrived around seven.”
atoms.b: The manager emphasizes that the guests ((would_have_arrived ++will_have_arrived will_arrive)) around seven.

feedback.wrong: Der Begleitsatz steht im simple present, weshalb kein backshift of tenses erfolgt.

atoms.a: She said, “He is going to talk to his supervisor about it.”
atoms.b: She said that he ((++was_going_to_talk is_going_to_talk will_have_talked)) to his supervisor about it.

feedback.wrong: Das going-to future der direkten Rede wird in der indirekten Rede zu was/were going to + Infinitiv.

instruction.text: Write the correct form of indirect speech.

atoms.a: Mr. Smith insisted, “We will launch the new product in October.”
atoms.b: Mr. Smith insisted that they ((would_launch)) the new product in October.

feedback.wrong: Das will-future der direkten Rede wird in der indirekten Rede zum conditional.

atoms.a: The CEO assured, “The company will have invested in renewable energy by the end of the year.”
atoms.b: The CEO assured the company ((would_have_invested)) in renewable energy by the end of that year.

feedback.wrong: Das future perfect der direkten Rede wird in der indirekten Rede zum conditional perfect.

atoms.a: They say, “We would reconsider the proposal under different circumstances.”
atoms.b: They say that they ((would_reconsider)) the proposal under different circumstances.

feedback.wrong: Der Begleitsatz steht im simple present, weshalb kein backshift of tenses erfolgt.

atoms.a: Marisol apologized, “I would have called you if I had known.”
atoms.b: Marisol apologized she ((would_have_called)) me if she had known.

feedback.wrong1: Das conditional perfect der direkten Rede bleibt in der indirekten Rede conditional perfect.
